items.title: Mortgage Rates Back on the Rise After Biggest Bond Rally Since 2023
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Bonds had one of their best days yesterday in more than three years. The 10-year yield plunged nearly 20 basis points, its biggest one-day drop since March 2023, even falling below 5% in the process. items.title: Mortgage Rates Move Lower Thanks to Record Low Pending Home Sales
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates are a little better today, but it might not be worth celebrating. The reason isn’t great, as it typically isn’t. items.title: Fannie Mae Ups 2027 Mortgage Rate Forecast to 7.5%
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Each month, Fannie Mae releases a forecast for home prices, sales, and mortgage rates, among other things. Between September’s report and October’s, they raised their estimate for the 30-year fixed a staggering 80 basis points (0.80%). The unusually large move reflects just how bad mortgage rates had it over the past month and change. But… Read More »

items.title: Mortgage Rates Keep Falling on AI Rout, But Will It Last?
